decision_rationale: Primary foundation-model paper on paired histopathology and spatial transcriptomics. The abstract describes image-expression pretraining and gene-expression prediction, but no substantive text/language component.
evidence_snippet: “Trained on over 17 million image-expression pairs ... predicting spatial gene expression from histology images”

decision_rationale: This is a CT-based predictive AI study for TLS mapping, not a candidate generative text-bio model. The model uses imaging/radiomics and interpretability analyses rather than a text-bio bridge.
evidence_snippet: “develop and validate a CT-based multi-modal artificial intelligence model for preoperative TLS prediction”

decision_rationale: The abstract foregrounds a new dataset/toolbox and segmentation framework for mitochondrial analysis. It is a resource/method paper with biological imaging, but no text component.
evidence_snippet: “integrated toolbox built upon PanoMitoAtlas ... largest multi-modal fluorescence mitochondrial dataset”

decision_rationale: This is explicitly a structured narrative review of AI for neonatal sepsis. It summarizes prior studies rather than presenting a primary candidate model.
evidence_snippet: “This structured narrative review summarizes current evidence regarding AI-based approaches”

decision_rationale: Primary multimodal pathology foundation-model paper grounded in transcriptomic and mutational supervision. The abstract supports biological modalities, but not a substantive text/language component.
evidence_snippet: “a multimodal pathology foundation model that grounds morphology in transcriptomic and mutational supervision”

decision_rationale: This is a conceptual framework/roadmap paper about virtual-cell world models, not a primary model paper. The abstract discusses evaluation gaps and motivation experiments rather than introducing a new candidate model.
evidence_snippet: “We introduce virtual-cell world models (VCWMs) as a structured framework for evaluation”

decision_rationale: This presents a new single-cell generative model for expression matrix generation. The abstract describes patch-based transformer denoising over gene-expression data, but not a text/language component.
evidence_snippet: “scJET, a patch-based Transformer denoising framework ... full-gene space”

decision_rationale: This is a diagnostic toolkit for perturbation readouts built around an existing Geneformer engine. The abstract frames it as assessing whether model outputs warrant biological interpretation, not a new text-bio model.
evidence_snippet: “a confound-diagnostic framework ... reimplementation of frozen Geneformer's perturbation engine”
